name: The Royal Surakarta Heritage - Handwritten Collection
short_description: A 150-room heritage hotel on Jalan Slamet Riyadi in Solo, near the Mangkunegaran and Kasunanan royal palaces and the Pasar Klewer market.
ai_summary: The Royal Surakarta Heritage, part of Accor's Handwritten Collection, sits on Jalan Slamet Riyadi in Solo alongside banking and government buildings, with the Mangkunegaran and Kasunanan royal palaces, the Pasar Klewer traditional textile market, and the central Grosir Solo shopping area all nearby. The 150-room property is positioned for both leisure and business travellers, with rooms including 24-hour room service, premium bedding, soaking tubs and LED TVs. The hotel's own ALL booking page could not be loaded directly for this research pass -- facts here are cross-checked across TripAdvisor, Expedia and Hotels.com listings rather than the official page.
